key_points: Accenture reported strong Q4 results with better-than-expected revenue and earnings.
Management raised AI-driven growth outlook, signaling longer-term tailwinds.
Stock dipped ~2% after a recent 16% surge, likely due to profit-taking rather than negative fundamentals.
Valuation models (e.g., GuruFocus DCF) suggest ACN may be undervalued around $236.
International revenue trends remain healthy, supporting diversified growth.
